name: Bebop
presentation_only: Palette, place names, crew drawings and captions only. Station membership, state names and every status word are canonical (lib/hub_ui/__init__.py) and cannot be changed by a theme.

sprite_style.note: Look is NOT final. Swap these knobs or the per-character sprite params to restyle without touching ui.js.

flavour: Somebody check the release before I check the bonsai.
